# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance

## Validation

- [ ] I ran the relevant local commands
- [ ] I reviewed changed files for unintended edits
- [ ] I updated documentation if behavior changed

## Checklist

- [ ] Linked issue or context
- [ ] No sensitive data added
- [ ] Ready for review
